metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.8 · 2009 · Red Riding: The Year of Our Lord 1974
metas.description: Rookie journalist Eddie Dunford is determined to find the truth in an increasingly complex maze of lies and deceit surrounding the police investigation into a series of child abductions.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.1 · 2009 · Red Riding: The Year of Our Lord 1980
metas.description: The Home Office bring in senior Manchester detective Peter Hunter to conduct a secret review of the Ripper investigation to date.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 7.1 · 2009 · Red Riding: The Year of Our Lord 1983
metas.description: When another child goes missing, washed-up solicitor John Piggott unwittingly provides a catalyst for Detective Chief Superindent Maurice Jobson to start to right some wrongs.
